Package cz.cuni.mff.vopalenf.annotator.service

Class TeamService

java.lang.Object
cz.cuni.mff.vopalenf.annotator.service.TeamService
@Service public class TeamService extends Object
Service for managing teams in the application. Provides methods to create, update, delete, and retrieve teams.
